limits: Predictions only come from JPL's catalogue of known bodies. A body faster than 0.4 degrees a day across the sky, fainter than magnitude 21, or not in the catalogue is not listed. The list says nothing about unknown objects.
credit: NASA/JPL Solar System Dynamics (Small-Body Identification API and Horizons)
observer_note: Positions are for the SPHEREx spacecraft's own position, from JPL Horizons. Sky motion includes the spacecraft's orbital motion.
wording: Each position is a prediction; the 'verdict' of an entry is what its exposure itself shows.
